verdicts.sentence: Most RAG projects rely on qualitative impressions, but a golden-question evaluation harness is required to measure retrieval quality objectively.

verdicts.sentence: In testing, the initial 30-question set incorrectly suggested that re-ranker quality was the binding constraint.
verdicts.why: The source states that on the 30-question set, 're-ranker quality looked like the binding constraint', which turned out to point at the wrong lever.

verdicts.sentence: Doubling the evaluation set to 60 questions revealed that query rewriting was a more pressing need.
verdicts.why: The source notes that expanding the set to 60 questions made query rewriting go from the least valuable lever to the most, as never-retrieved failures became the largest bucket.

verdicts.sentence: Retrieval performance is often hindered by technical artifacts.
verdicts.why: The source discusses specific technical issues in this project but does not make this general claim.

verdicts.sentence: The pdfplumber tool frequently emits words welded together, which causes FTS5 to tokenize them as a single token.
verdicts.why: The source directly states that pdfplumber frequently emits words welded together and that FTS5 tokenizes each weld as one token.

verdicts.sentence: All-lowercase welds accounted for 1,971 / 2,144 (92%) of chunks containing a 16+ character weld.

verdicts.sentence: Implementing vocabulary-based re-spacing reduced the share of welded tokens from 10.2% to 5.4% and raised recall@5 from 0.683 to 0.767.

verdicts.sentence: Aggregate metrics can be misleading when they contradict the retrieval hypothesis.
verdicts.why: The source describes a specific proxy metric that was the wrong instrument because it measured whole-chunk noise, not that aggregate metrics in general are misleading when they contradict a hypothesis.

Table-aware ingestion decreased recall@5 from 0.733 to 0.667 because it introduced near-duplicate chunks that crowded the re-ranker.

Most RAG projects skip the golden-question evaluation harness, relying on qualitative impressions instead of measuring retrieval quality with numbers.

The system uses SQLite with the sqlite-vec extension for local, zero-infrastructure vector storage. The bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding model is local, 384-dimensional, and requires no API key.

Hybrid retrieval improved recall@5 from 0.500 to 0.733. Adding a re-ranker improved recall@5 from 0.467 to 0.500.

Increasing the re-rank pool from 20 to 50 candidates decreased recall@5 from 0.733 to 0.700 because the extra distractors cost more than the recovered answers.

All-lowercase welds accounted for 1,971 / 2,144 (92%) of chunks containing a 16+ character weld. Vocabulary-based re-spacing reduced the share of welded tokens from 10.2% to 5.4%.
